notes.zh-CN: 编辑已发送的消息时，编辑框现在是整条气泡的宽度，长消息不再被挤成窄条反复折行；输入越多自动增高，最多约 22rem。图片预览新增右键复制：在预览大图或对话里的缩略图上点右键选「复制图片」，就能把这张图直接粘贴到其他应用。
notes.en: Editing a sent message now opens at the width of a full bubble instead of a narrow strip, so a long message stops wrapping every few words; the box also grows taller as you type, up to about 22rem. Image previews gain right-click copy: choose “Copy image” on the preview or on a thumbnail in the transcript to paste that picture into another app.
